faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Project Nurse-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Project Nurse-II position at AIIMS Delhi is 08 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Nurse-II post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Minimum Second Class or equivalent CGPA in a three-year General Nursing and Midwife (GNM) Course to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Nurse-II position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Nurse-II post is 30 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per ICMR Guidelines.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the AIIMS Delhi Project Nurse-II recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your complete application along with required documents to the official email address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies for the Project Nurse-II post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Project Nurse-II position announced by AIIMS Delhi.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves an Application Screening. Further details will be communicated to shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual position. The terms and duration of the contract will be as per the project requirements and AIIMS Delhi guidelines.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section provided in this article. It contains all detailed information.

faq.question: Q10. What documents do I need to submit with my application?
faq.answer: You need to attach self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs with your application.
